applies_why: The judge text states a RESULT awarding DEFENDER WINS, so the RESULT rule governs it.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1;
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: 'A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count' — I weighed whether this removes the retracted D2 vs C3 link-broken grade and its stated standing reason from counting, or whether the earlier DEFENDER WINS could still rely on that retracted material.
why: The judge awards DEFENDER WINS even though the only stated basis for non-self-support and the D2 vs C3 CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade are shown as retracted, so no valid condition under the rule supports that result.
